project.name: frappe
project.description: Metadata driven, full-stack low code web framework for building real world applications in Python and JavaScript. Built for ERPNext with 700+ object types.

nodes.name: momentjs.py
nodes.summary: Timezone data module for moment.js integration. Contains a massive static data dictionary of timezone zones, rules, and links used for client-side timezone handling. Provides update() to extract timezone info and get_all_timezones() to list available timezones.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Extracts timezone zone, link, and rule data for a given timezone into an output dictionary for moment.js consumption.

nodes.name: get_all_timezones
nodes.summary: Returns a sorted list of all available timezone names from the static data dictionary.

nodes.name: data.py
nodes.summary: Core utility module providing ~100+ helper functions for date/time manipulation (getdate, get_datetime, add_to_date, format_date, now), number formatting (flt, cint, rounded), string operations (cstr, strip_html, sanitize), URL handling (get_url, expand_relative_urls), JSON serialization (orjson-based), filtering/comparison, and data type casting. The backbone utility module imported throughout frappe.

nodes.name: Weekday
nodes.summary: Enum representing days of the week (Sunday=0 through Saturday=6) used for week start calculations.

nodes.name: getdate
nodes.summary: Converts string date (yyyy-mm-dd) to datetime.date object. Uses fromisoformat for performance, falls back to dateutil parser.

nodes.name: get_datetime
nodes.summary: Converts various date/time representations (string, date, tuple, None) to datetime.datetime object. Returns current datetime if None.

nodes.name: add_to_date
nodes.summary: Adds years, months, days, hours, minutes, seconds to a date/datetime. Supports multiple overloads for different parameter combinations.

nodes.name: now_datetime
nodes.summary: Returns the current datetime, respecting the system timezone setting.

nodes.name: format_date
nodes.summary: Formats a date string according to user or specified format string, with locale-aware formatting.

nodes.name: format_duration
nodes.summary: Converts seconds to human-readable duration string (e.g., '2d 3h 45m 30s').

nodes.name: get_timespan_date_range
nodes.summary: Returns a date range tuple for named timespans like 'last week', 'this month', 'next quarter' etc.

nodes.name: compare
nodes.summary: Generic comparison function supporting operators like =, !=, >, <, like, in, between, etc. Used for filter evaluation throughout the framework.

nodes.name: get_filter
nodes.summary: Parses various filter formats (dict, list, tuple) into a standardized frappe._dict filter object with doctype, fieldname, operator, and value.

nodes.name: scrub_urls
nodes.summary: Converts relative URLs in HTML content to absolute URLs using the site URL.

nodes.name: orjson_dumps
nodes.summary: JSON serialization using orjson with frappe-specific options for datetime passthrough and non-string keys.

nodes.name: list_view.js
nodes.summary: Main list view implementation for frappe's document listing. Extends BaseList to provide full-featured list UI with sorting, filtering, column configuration, bulk operations, pagination, status indicators, tag display, like functionality, and keyboard shortcuts. Handles rendering of list rows with configurable columns, count display, and action menus.

nodes.name: ListView
nodes.summary: Main list view class extending BaseList. Manages document listing with sorting, filtering, column rendering, bulk operations, pagination, count display, and various view modes. Contains 120+ methods for complete list management.

nodes.name: query.py
nodes.summary: Core database query engine that builds SQL queries using pypika query builder. The Engine class handles field parsing, filter application (including nested/OR filters), permission checking, group by, order by, and join generation for child/link tables. Supports SQL function parsing, field-level permissions, user permission conditions, and dynamic table fields for child tables and linked documents.

nodes.name: Engine
nodes.summary: Main query engine class that builds pypika queries with field selection, filtering (simple, nested, OR), permission enforcement, group by, order by, and join management. Core method get_query() orchestrates the full query building pipeline. Contains 60+ methods.

nodes.name: DynamicTableField
nodes.summary: Represents a field from a dynamically-joined table (child or linked). Handles parsing field references with dot notation and applying appropriate JOINs.

nodes.name: ChildTableField
nodes.summary: Extends DynamicTableField for child table fields, applying LEFT JOINs on parent-child relationships.

nodes.name: SQLFunctionParser
nodes.summary: Parses SQL function dictionaries (COUNT, SUM, AVG, etc.) and arithmetic operator dictionaries into pypika query components with permission validation.

nodes.name: query_report.js
nodes.summary: Query report view implementation. Extends BaseList to render script/query-based reports with DataTable integration, chart generation, filter management, prepared report support, print/PDF export, and dashboard chart/number card creation. Handles report loading, data refresh, column formatting, and various output formats.

nodes.name: QueryReport
nodes.summary: Query report class extending BaseList. Manages report display with DataTable rendering, chart integration, filter handling, prepared reports, export to CSV/Excel/PDF, and dashboard chart creation. Contains 110+ methods.

nodes.name: document.py
nodes.summary: Core Document class - the base controller for all DocType records in frappe. Provides CRUD operations (insert, save, submit, cancel, delete), validation pipeline, permission checking, workflow support, child table management, version tracking, caching, and event hooks. Also includes get_doc() factory function, copy_doc(), new_doc(), LazyDocument, and document caching utilities.

nodes.name: Document
nodes.summary: Central ORM class inheriting from BaseDocument. All DocType controllers inherit from this. Provides load_from_db, insert, save, submit, cancel, delete, reload, permission checking, validation pipeline (_validate, _validate_mandatory, _validate_links), child table management, workflow validation, db_set/db_get for direct DB updates, and hook-based event system.

nodes.name: get_doc
nodes.summary: Factory function to create/load Document objects. Supports multiple calling conventions: by doctype+name, by dict, by kwargs, or passing an existing Document. Uses singledispatch for type-based routing.

nodes.name: new_doc
nodes.summary: Creates a new Document instance for the given DocType with default values applied.

nodes.name: copy_doc
nodes.summary: Creates a deep copy of a Document, resetting identity fields and optionally preserving no-copy fields.

nodes.name: get_cached_doc
nodes.summary: Retrieves a Document from cache or loads it from DB, caching the result for subsequent calls.

nodes.name: LazyDocument
nodes.summary: Lazy-loading Document proxy that defers DB loading until attributes are actually accessed, improving performance for unused document references.

nodes.name: form.js
nodes.summary: Main form view implementation for displaying and editing individual documents. Creates FrappeForm class with layout rendering, field management, toolbar, sidebar, permissions, workflow actions, keyboard shortcuts, file drag-drop, print/email integration, undo manager, and document state management (dirty tracking, save, submit, amend, cancel).

nodes.name: FrappeForm
nodes.summary: Main form class (frappe.ui.form.Form) for document display/editing. Handles layout setup, field rendering, toolbar, sidebar, permissions, save/submit/cancel actions, dirty tracking, reload, keyboard shortcuts, and various document operations. Contains 130+ methods.

nodes.name: utils.js
nodes.summary: Core JavaScript utility library (frappe.utils namespace). Provides 100+ utility functions including string manipulation (pluralize, escape_html, xss_sanitise), number formatting (format_number, format_currency), URL generation (get_form_link, generate_route), DOM helpers (scroll, icon rendering), clipboard operations, debounce/throttle, browser detection, chart utilities, print functionality, filter processing, and various formatting helpers.

nodes.name: doctype.py
nodes.summary: DocType controller - manages the metadata definition of document types in frappe. Handles validation of fields (names, types, options, permissions), auto-naming configuration, controller file generation, module setup, nested set support, child table configuration, export/import of DocType definitions, and schema management. Contains extensive field validation functions.

nodes.name: DocType
nodes.summary: DocType Document controller inheriting from Document. Validates field definitions, manages auto-naming, generates controller templates, handles export/import, manages permissions, syncs global search, and handles schema migrations. Contains 50+ methods for DocType lifecycle management.

nodes.name: validate_fields
nodes.summary: Comprehensive field validation function that checks field names, types, options, mandatory settings, link targets, default values, precision, search fields, title fields, and many other constraints across all fields in a DocType's meta.

nodes.name: validate_permissions
nodes.summary: Validates DocType permission rules ensuring proper role assignments, permission level consistency, and valid permission combinations.

nodes.name: sqlite_search.py
nodes.summary: SQLite FTS5-based full-text search engine for frappe. Abstract base class SQLiteSearch provides search with spelling correction (trigram similarity), time-based recency boosting, custom scoring pipeline, BM25 ranking, vocabulary building, incremental indexing with progress tracking, permission-aware filtering, and structured warning system. Supports background index building and document queue processing.

nodes.name: SQLiteSearch
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for SQLite FTS5 search. Provides search(), build_index(), index_doc(), remove_doc() with scoring pipeline (title boost, recency boost, custom scoring functions), spelling correction via trigram similarity, vocabulary management, connection pooling with pragmas, and structured warning/progress tracking. Contains 70+ methods.

nodes.name: build_index
nodes.summary: Module-level function to build search index, orchestrating SQLiteSearch subclass instantiation and index building with background job support.

nodes.name: update_doc_index
nodes.summary: Hook function called on document save to update the search index for a single document across all registered search classes.

nodes.name: get_search_classes
nodes.summary: Discovers and returns all registered SQLiteSearch subclasses from hooks configuration.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Core Frappe framework initialization module. Defines global state (db, cache, session, user, flags, etc.), site initialization/teardown, Redis cache setup, permission checking, hooks system, module/app management, and re-exports key APIs (get_doc, get_meta, whitelist, etc.). Acts as the central API surface for the entire framework.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Initialize frappe for the current site. Resets thread locals, loads site config, sets up module map, and initializes Redis cache connection.

nodes.name: connect
nodes.summary: Connect to the site database instance using credentials from site_config.json. Optionally sets Administrator as current user.

nodes.name: whitelist
nodes.summary: Decorator for whitelisting functions and making them accessible via HTTP API. Supports allow_guest, xss_safe, and HTTP method restrictions. Validates argument types.

nodes.name: get_hooks
nodes.summary: Get hooks from app hooks.py files. Uses request/site caching. Returns hook values as a list or dict, optionally filtered by hook name or app.

nodes.name: has_permission
nodes.summary: Check if user has a specific permission type (read/write/create/submit etc.) for a doctype or document. Optionally raises PermissionError.

nodes.name: setup_module_map
nodes.summary: Rebuild the map of all modules across apps. Creates forward (app->modules) and reverse (module->app) mappings, cached in Redis.

nodes.name: get_all_apps
nodes.summary: Get list of all apps from sites/apps.txt and site-specific apps.txt. Ensures frappe is always first.

nodes.name: init_site
nodes.summary: Context manager for site initialization and teardown. Calls init() on enter and destroy() on exit.

nodes.name: site.py
nodes.summary: CLI commands for site management using Click. Provides commands for creating, restoring, backing up, migrating, dropping sites, installing/uninstalling apps, managing users and passwords, and database operations (trim, index, describe).

nodes.name: new_site
nodes.summary: Click command to create a new Frappe site with database setup, optional app installation, and rollback support on failure.

nodes.name: restore
nodes.summary: Click command to restore a site database from an SQL file, with support for encrypted backups and public/private file restoration.

nodes.name: migrate
nodes.summary: Click command to run patches, sync schema, and rebuild files/translations during site migration.

nodes.name: backup
nodes.summary: Click command to create site backup with optional file inclusion, encryption, compression, and selective doctype inclusion/exclusion.

nodes.name: install_app
nodes.summary: Click command to install one or more apps on a site, with file locking and error handling.

nodes.name: drop_site
nodes.summary: Click command to remove a site by dropping its database and archiving its filesystem.

nodes.name: trim_database
nodes.summary: Click command to remove database tables for deleted DocTypes, with optional backup and dry-run mode.

nodes.name: base_document.py
nodes.summary: Defines BaseDocument class - the foundational document class in Frappe's ORM. Handles document CRUD (db_insert/db_update), field validation (mandatory, length, selects, links, constants), child table management, serialization (as_dict/as_json), password handling, and XSS sanitization. Also provides controller loading via get_controller/import_controller and class extension mechanism.

nodes.name: BaseDocument
nodes.summary: Core document class providing get/set/update operations, child table management (append/extend/remove), database operations (db_insert/db_update), field validation (mandatory, length, links, selects, constants), serialization, password handling, and permission-level field resets.

nodes.name: get_controller
nodes.summary: Return the cached controller class for a given DocType. Handles custom doctypes, class overrides via hooks, and extension classes.

nodes.name: import_controller
nodes.summary: Import and return the controller class for a DocType. Handles module loading, class overrides from hooks, tree doctypes (NestedSet), and class extensions.

nodes.name: _filter
nodes.summary: Filter a list of document-like objects using dict-based filter syntax supporting operators like =, !=, in, not in, ^(startswith), True/False existence checks.

nodes.name: database.py
nodes.summary: Core Database abstraction class providing SQL execution, value get/set operations, transaction management (commit/rollback/savepoint), bulk operations, table/column introspection, and query logging. Supports MariaDB, PostgreSQL, and SQLite backends. Also provides savepoint context manager and query execution timeout utilities.

nodes.name: Database
nodes.summary: Abstract database connection class. Provides sql() for query execution, get_value/set_value for document properties, get_single_value/set_single_value for Single DocTypes, transaction control (commit/rollback/savepoint), bulk_insert/bulk_update, table/column introspection, and connection management.

nodes.name: savepoint
nodes.summary: Context manager/decorator wrapping DB operations in a savepoint. Rolls back to savepoint on specified exception types, otherwise releases the savepoint.

nodes.name: get_query_execution_timeout
nodes.summary: Calculate query execution timeout based on context (HTTP request, background job, or console). Applies 1.5x safety factor.

nodes.name: db_query.py
nodes.summary: DatabaseQuery class that builds and executes SQL queries for list views and report views. Handles field extraction, table joins, permission-based filtering, user settings, virtual doctype delegation, field masking, SQL sanitization, and result formatting. Legacy query builder used alongside the newer QB system.

nodes.name: DatabaseQuery
nodes.summary: Builds parameterized SQL queries for document list retrieval with permission checks, field-level access control, user settings persistence, virtual doctype support, and result masking. Primary entry point is execute() method.

nodes.name: user.py
nodes.summary: User DocType controller implementing user lifecycle management: creation, validation, role/permission management, password handling (reset, strength test, update), session management, email notifications, contact sync, sign-up, impersonation, and API key generation.

nodes.name: User
nodes.summary: Document controller for User DocType. Handles validation (email, roles, username, password strength), lifecycle hooks (on_update, on_trash, before_rename), role profile management, session tracking, social login, welcome emails, and permission checks.

nodes.name: update_password
nodes.summary: Whitelisted API endpoint to update user password. Validates password strength, checks reset key or old password, prevents reuse, and handles post-reset redirect.

nodes.name: sign_up
nodes.summary: Whitelisted guest-accessible API for user self-registration. Throttles signups, creates Website User with random password, assigns default role, and sends verification email.

nodes.name: create_contact
nodes.summary: Creates or updates a Contact document linked to a User, syncing name, email, phone, and mobile number fields.

nodes.name: impersonate
nodes.summary: Whitelisted API to impersonate another user. Logs activity, sends notification and email alert to the target user.

nodes.name: report_view.js
nodes.summary: ReportView class extending ListView for tabular report display using frappe-datatable. Provides column configuration, sorting, grouping, charting, totals rows, report saving/loading, CSV/Excel/clipboard export, and user settings persistence.

nodes.name: ReportView
nodes.summary: Report view UI component extending ListView. Renders data in a DataTable with column management, sort/group controls, chart visualization, totals row, and report save/export functionality.

nodes.name: leaflet.draw.js
nodes.summary: Leaflet.draw v0.4.12 - third-party plugin adding drawing and editing tools (polyline, polygon, rectangle, circle, marker) to Leaflet maps. Vendored library, not Frappe-authored.

nodes.name: grid_row.js
nodes.summary: GridRow class for rendering individual rows in child table grids within Frappe forms. Handles row rendering (template or column-based), inline editing, row actions (add/remove/move/duplicate), form view toggle, field dependency evaluation, and copy-paste support.

nodes.name: GridRow
nodes.summary: Renders a single row in a child table grid. Manages column rendering, inline editing controls, row selection/check, insert/remove/move operations, form view toggling, and field dependency evaluation.

nodes.name: base_list.js
nodes.summary: BaseList class providing the foundation for all list-based views in Frappe. Handles page setup, field/filter configuration, data fetching, result rendering, pagination, view menu, and action buttons. Extended by ListView, ReportView, etc.

nodes.name: BaseList
nodes.summary: Base class for list views. Provides initialization pipeline (fetch_meta, setup_fields, setup_page, etc.), data fetching via frappe.call, field management, filter setup, pagination, view switching menu, and action buttons.

nodes.name: grid.js
nodes.summary: Grid component for child table fields in forms. Manages rendering, pagination, sorting, filtering, row CRUD operations, column visibility, bulk edit (CSV upload/download), and editable grid functionality. Central UI component for table-type fields.

nodes.name: Grid
nodes.summary: Main grid class that renders child table fields in forms. Handles row creation/deletion/duplication, pagination, sorting via Sortable.js, column visibility configuration, filtering, bulk edit via CSV upload/download, and editable grid mode. Contains ~1400 lines with 40+ methods.

nodes.name: desktop.js
nodes.summary: Desktop page implementation with customizable icon grid layout. Features drag-and-drop reordering, folder creation, edit mode with save/discard, icon show/hide pane, modal views for folder contents, inline title editing, avatar menu, notifications, and awesomebar integration.

nodes.name: DesktopPage
nodes.summary: Main desktop page controller. Manages layout editing, icon rendering, save/sync of layouts to server, avatar setup, notifications, navbar, awesomebar, and route change handling.

nodes.name: DesktopIconGrid
nodes.summary: Grid container for desktop icons. Handles pagination, swipe gestures, arrow navigation, Sortable-based drag-and-drop reordering, and folder creation.

nodes.name: DesktopIcon
nodes.summary: Individual desktop icon component. Handles click routing, edit mode with context menus, drag behavior, folder thumbnail rendering, and hide/show toggle.

nodes.name: DesktopModal
nodes.summary: Modal dialog for displaying folder contents on the desktop. Supports back navigation through modal stack and edit mode icon reordering.

nodes.name: InlineEditor
nodes.summary: Inline text editor for renaming desktop folder titles. Supports keyboard shortcuts (Enter to commit, Escape to cancel) and auto-resizing input.

nodes.name: importer.py
nodes.summary: Data import engine that handles CSV/XLSX/XLS file parsing and bulk document insertion/update. Contains Importer (orchestrates import), ImportFile (parses template files), Row (validates and parses individual data rows), Header (maps column headers to docfields), and Column (validates column values and guesses date formats).

nodes.name: Importer
nodes.summary: Main import orchestrator. Manages import lifecycle (before/after hooks), processes documents row by row with error handling, supports insert and update modes, tracks progress via realtime events, handles retry/resume with import logs, and exports errored rows.

nodes.name: ImportFile
nodes.summary: Handles reading and parsing import template files (CSV/XLSX/XLS/Google Sheets). Extracts headers, data rows, and payloads for import. Supports parent-child document parsing and generates warnings.

nodes.name: Row
nodes.summary: Represents a single data row in the import file. Validates values (Select, Link, Date, Datetime, Duration fields), parses values to appropriate Python types, and constructs document dicts from row data.

nodes.name: Header
nodes.summary: Represents the header row of an import file. Maps column headers to docfields, identifies parent and child doctypes, and provides column index lookup.

nodes.name: Column
nodes.summary: Represents a single column in the import template. Parses header to find matching docfield, validates column values (Link existence, Select options, Date format guessing), and generates warnings.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Core utility module exporting 80+ utility functions. Includes email validation/parsing, URL validation, IBAN validation, phone number validation, gravatar handling, traceback formatting, shell execution, file/path utilities, progress bar, HTML/markdown processing, site info, batch processing, and the CallbackManager class. Re-exports all from frappe.utils.data.

nodes.name: CallbackManager
nodes.summary: Queue-based callback manager using deque. Supports adding functions to queue, running all in order, and resetting. Used for frappe.db.after_commit pattern.

nodes.name: validate_email_address
nodes.summary: Validates email address strings using stdlib getaddresses parser and regex matching. Supports multiple comma/newline-separated emails, filters undisclosed recipients, and optionally throws InvalidEmailAddressError.

nodes.name: get_traceback
nodes.summary: Returns formatted traceback string for the current exception. Supports optional context-aware tracing via traceback_with_variables with sanitization of sensitive values (passwords, tokens, keys).

nodes.name: execute_in_shell
nodes.summary: Executes shell commands using subprocess.Popen with proper output capture. Supports low priority execution via os.nice and exit code checking.

nodes.name: get_site_info
nodes.summary: Collects comprehensive site information including installed apps, users, system settings, space usage, scheduler status, and recent logins. Extensible via get_site_info hooks.

nodes.name: email_account.py
nodes.summary: EmailAccount DocType controller managing email sending and receiving. Handles IMAP/POP3 incoming connections, SMTP outgoing, OAuth authentication, Frappe Mail integration, auto-reply, DSN validation, folder validation, unreplied notification, and user inbox setup. Contains helper functions for email pulling, account discovery, and setup.

nodes.name: EmailAccount
nodes.summary: Document controller for Email Account. Manages email account lifecycle with validation of IMAP/SMTP connections, OAuth token handling, email receiving with error recovery, auto-reply, Frappe Mail integration, and default account management. Contains 30+ methods and class methods for account discovery (find_outgoing, find_incoming, find_default_outgoing).

nodes.name: pull
nodes.summary: Scheduler entry point for pulling emails from all enabled Email Accounts. Enqueues background jobs for each account, respecting OAuth token availability.

nodes.name: notify_unreplied
nodes.summary: Sends email notifications for unreplied Communications based on Email Account configuration. Checks time thresholds and document status before sending.

nodes.name: communication.js
nodes.summary: Email composition dialog (CommunicationComposer) for sending emails from within Frappe. Features rich text editor, email templates with HTML support, recipient auto-complete (To/CC/BCC), attachments, print format selection, draft saving via localforage, signature management, reply threading with quoted content, schedule send, and undo send functionality.

nodes.name: CommunicationComposer
nodes.summary: Email composition dialog class with 30+ methods. Handles email field setup, recipient resolution, subject threading, email template integration, attachment management, draft persistence, signature fetching, HTML/rich-text toggle, print format attachment, and email sending with undo capability.

nodes.name: meta.py
nodes.summary: DocType metadata loading and processing module. The Meta class extends Document to provide metadata access for doctypes including field introspection, custom field/property setter application, permission management, dashboard data, field ordering, currency/precision resolution, and table column management. Core to the metadata-driven architecture.

nodes.name: Meta
nodes.summary: Core metadata class representing a DocType's schema. Processes custom fields, property setters, permissions, links/actions/states. Provides field lookup by name, type-based field queries (link, select, image, code fields), permission level access, search fields, dashboard data, naming series, workflow, and web templates. Uses cached_property extensively for performance.

nodes.name: get_meta
nodes.summary: Factory function for Meta objects with client-side caching. Returns cached Meta instance or creates new one for the given doctype.

nodes.name: get_field_currency
nodes.summary: Resolves currency for a Currency-type field based on DocField options and document values. Handles parent document currency lookup and colon-separated option format.

nodes.name: trim_tables
nodes.summary: Maintenance function to remove database columns that no longer exist in DocType definitions. Iterates all non-single, non-virtual doctypes and drops orphaned columns.

nodes.name: query_report.py
nodes.summary: Query/Script report execution engine. Handles report running (Query, Script, Custom types), result generation with column normalization, custom column data fetching, prepared report integration, Excel/CSV export with filtering and formatting, total row calculation, user permission filtering with field masking, report saving, and filter validation.

nodes.name: generate_report_result
nodes.summary: Main report result generator. Executes report, normalizes results to list of dicts, applies custom columns, filters by user permissions, adds total row, and returns structured result with columns, message, chart, and summary.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Whitelist entry point for running reports. Validates filter permissions, handles prepared reports vs live execution, applies default filters, and manages total row calculation.

nodes.name: export_query
nodes.summary: Exports query report results to CSV or Excel format. Supports background export with email delivery, visible row filtering, hidden column inclusion, and filter display in output.

nodes.name: add_total_row
nodes.summary: Adds a total row to report results, summing Currency/Int/Float/Percent/Duration columns. Handles tree reports, visible row filtering, percent averaging, and time accumulation.

nodes.name: get_filtered_data
nodes.summary: Filters report data based on user permissions. Applies field masking, owner-based filtering, shared document access, and linked doctype permission matching.

nodes.name: link.js
nodes.summary: Link field control with Awesomplete-based autocomplete. Features search with server-side query, filter description display, link title resolution, new document creation, advanced search, fetch_from field value propagation, custom query support, link validation, HTTP caching for GET requests, and translatable link titles.

nodes.name: ControlLink
nodes.summary: Link field form control extending ControlData. Implements Awesomplete autocomplete with server-side search, filter description rendering, link title display, new doc creation, advanced search dialog, fetch_from value propagation, custom query configuration, link validation with fetch, and intelligent GET/POST selection based on filter size.

nodes.name: utils.py
nodes.summary: CLI utility commands for bench operations. Includes build (asset compilation), watch, clear-cache, console (IPython), serve (dev server), database consoles (mariadb/postgres/sqlite), data-import, export commands, version display, config management, permission reset, global search rebuild, and database transformation commands.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: CLI command to compile JS/CSS assets. Handles asset downloading, esbuild bundling in development/production modes, translation compilation, and file locking for concurrent builds.

nodes.name: serve
nodes.summary: CLI command to start the development web server with options for port, profiling, proxy support, auto-reload, threading, and code coverage.

nodes.name: data_import
nodes.summary: CLI command for bulk document import from CSV/XLSX files. Wraps frappe.core.doctype.data_import.data_import.import_file with console mode.

nodes.name: console
nodes.summary: CLI command to start an IPython console with all installed apps imported into namespace. Supports autoreload and logs session history.

nodes.name: deprecation_dumpster.py
nodes.summary: Central repository for all deprecated functions and methods in the Frappe framework. Provides deprecation decorators with graduation dates, warning classes (FrappeDeprecationError, FrappeDeprecationWarning, PendingFrappeDeprecationWarning), and houses deprecated functions that were moved here from their original locations. Includes a compatibility FrappeTestCase class for legacy test support.

nodes.name: deprecated
nodes.summary: Decorator factory that wraps a function/method as deprecated with original name, marked date, graduation version, and user-facing message. Enforces that deprecated functions can only be defined in this file.

nodes.name: deprecation_warning
nodes.summary: Issues an in-place deprecation warning from a deprecated code path with marked date and graduation version.

nodes.name: get_tests_CompatFrappeTestCase
nodes.summary: Returns a backward-compatible FrappeTestCase class that provides test utilities like assertDocumentEqual, assertQueryCount, assertRedisCallCounts, freeze_time, and database connection management for legacy test support.

nodes.name: FrappeDeprecationError
nodes.summary: Warning class for deprecated features in the current version that raises an error by default.

nodes.name: FrappeDeprecationWarning
nodes.summary: Warning class for deprecated features targeted for the next version.

nodes.name: boilerplate.py
nodes.summary: Generates boilerplate code for new Frappe apps. Creates directory structure, configuration files (pyproject.toml, hooks.py, patches.txt), GitHub workflow files, .gitignore, README, pre-commit config, and initializes git. Also provides PatchCreator class for creating new migration patches interactively.

nodes.name: make_boilerplate
nodes.summary: Entry point for creating a new Frappe app boilerplate at a given destination directory. Collects user inputs and generates the app structure.

nodes.name: _create_app_boilerplate
nodes.summary: Creates the full app directory structure, writes template files (hooks.py, pyproject.toml, patches.txt, etc.), copies editor config, optionally creates GitHub workflows, and initializes a git repository.

nodes.name: PatchCreator
nodes.summary: Interactive CLI tool to create migration patch files. Prompts user for app name, doctype, and patch description, then creates the patch file and updates patches.txt.

nodes.name: translate.py
nodes.summary: Core translation module for Frappe. Handles loading translations from CSV/MO files, merging app and user translations, extracting translatable strings from Python/JS/HTML files, managing translation cache, and providing APIs for translation CRUD operations and language detection from HTTP requests.

nodes.name: get_language
nodes.summary: Determines the current language from HTTP request headers, cookies, user preferences, or system settings with a defined priority order.

nodes.name: get_all_translations
nodes.summary: Loads and returns the complete merged translations dictionary for a language, combining app translations, user translations, and country translations with parent language fallback. Results are cached in Redis.

nodes.name: get_messages_for_app
nodes.summary: Returns all translatable messages for a specified app by scanning doctypes, pages, reports, workflows, custom fields, JS files, server code, and navbar items.

nodes.name: get_messages_from_file
nodes.summary: Extracts translatable strings from a source code file (.py, .js, .html) using babel extractors and regex-based extraction.

nodes.name: extract_messages_from_python_code
nodes.summary: Extracts translatable strings from Python code using babel's extract_python with _() and _lt() keywords.

nodes.name: get_messages_from_doctype
nodes.summary: Extracts all translatable messages from a DocType including field labels, descriptions, select options, permissions roles, and associated JS/HTML files.

nodes.name: kanban_board.bundle.js
nodes.summary: Kanban board view implementation using Vuex store. Manages kanban columns and cards with drag-and-drop via Sortable.js. Handles card CRUD, column management (add/archive/restore), ordering, indicator colors, and integrates with Frappe's form customization for Select field options.

nodes.name: frappe.views.KanbanBoard
nodes.summary: Main kanban board controller that initializes the Vuex store, manages columns, sets up drag-and-drop sorting, and handles column add/restore UI interactions.

nodes.name: frappe.views.KanbanBoardColumn
nodes.summary: Kanban column component that renders cards, sets up card drag-and-drop sorting, and provides add-card and column options (archive, indicator color) UI.

nodes.name: frappe.views.KanbanBoardCard
nodes.summary: Kanban card component that renders card title, meta info (tags, comments, assignees, likes), color indicator, and handles assignment dialog interactions.

nodes.name: receive.py
nodes.summary: Email receiving module with IMAP/POP3 server connectivity and email parsing. EmailServer handles connections, mail retrieval, and UID management. Email class parses raw emails (headers, content, attachments). InboundMail processes received emails into Communication documents with reference document matching.

nodes.name: EmailServer
nodes.summary: Wrapper for POP3/IMAP email servers. Handles SSL/TLS/OAuth connections, mail retrieval with UID validation, folder selection, email flag management, and retry logic.

nodes.name: Email
nodes.summary: Email wrapper that parses raw email messages including headers (subject, from, date), multipart content (text/html), attachments with CID mapping, and character set detection.

nodes.name: InboundMail
nodes.summary: Extends Email to process inbound mail into Communication documents. Handles deduplication, reference document matching by subject/sender, parent email queue and communication threading, and creates new reference documents when needed.

nodes.name: notification.py
nodes.summary: Notification DocType controller for sending automated notifications via Email, Slack, SMS, or System Notification channels. Supports event triggers (New, Save, Submit, Cancel, Days/Minutes Before/After, Value Change, Method), condition evaluation (Python/Filters), template rendering, and recipient resolution from document fields, roles, and assignees.

nodes.name: Notification
nodes.summary: Document controller for Notification DocType. Handles validation, sending notifications across channels (Email/Slack/SMS/System), preview rendering, recipient list building, attachment handling, and standard template loading.

nodes.name: evaluate_alert
nodes.summary: Evaluates a notification alert against a document, checking conditions (Python/Filters) and value changes, then dispatches the notification via the configured channel.

nodes.name: trigger_notifications
nodes.summary: Triggers daily and offset-based notifications by finding matching documents and evaluating notification alerts for each.

nodes.name: installer.py
nodes.summary: Site and app installation/uninstallation module. Handles new site creation with database setup, app installation with dependency resolution, app removal with module/doctype cleanup, site config management, database backup validation, and MariaDB version compatibility handling.

nodes.name: _new_site
nodes.summary: Creates a new Frappe site with database setup, installs frappe and configured apps, manages scheduler state, and handles rollback callbacks.

nodes.name: install_app
nodes.summary: Installs a Frappe app on a site: resolves dependencies, syncs doctypes, runs before/after install hooks, syncs fixtures, customizations, dashboards, and scheduled jobs.

nodes.name: remove_app
nodes.summary: Removes an app from a site: checks dependencies, runs uninstall hooks, deletes modules and doctypes, takes backup, and clears caches.

nodes.name: install_db
nodes.summary: Sets up the database for a new site: creates config, bootstraps database from SQL, creates auth/global search/user settings tables.

nodes.name: update_site_config
nodes.summary: Updates a key-value pair in site_config.json with file locking and config cache clearing.

nodes.name: toolbar.js
nodes.summary: Form toolbar component that manages the action bar on document forms. Handles title display/editing, document status indicators, primary actions (Save/Submit/Update/Cancel/Amend), menu items (Email, Duplicate, Delete, Rename, Reload), navigation between records, document renaming, follow/unfollow, and customization buttons.

nodes.name: frappe.ui.form.Toolbar
nodes.summary: Form toolbar class managing document form actions, title editing, status indicators, menu items, navigation, rename operations, follow/unfollow, sidebar toggle, and permission-based UI control.

nodes.name: page.js
nodes.summary: Base page layout component providing standard page structure with toolbar, title area, primary/secondary actions, menu/actions dropdowns, inner buttons, form fields, sidebar, views, keyboard shortcuts, and responsive mobile support.

nodes.name: frappe.ui.Page
nodes.summary: Core page layout class with methods for setting title, indicators, primary/secondary actions, menu/action dropdown items, inner buttons, form fields, sidebar management, views, keyboard shortcuts, and scroll handling.

nodes.name: permissions.py
nodes.summary: Core permission system for Frappe. Implements has_permission with role-based, owner-based, user permission, controller permission, and share-based access control. Manages DocPerm and Custom DocPerm, role resolution, child doctype permission delegation, and provides utilities for adding/removing/resetting permissions.

nodes.name: has_permission
nodes.summary: Main permission check function evaluating role permissions, document-level permissions, user permissions, share permissions, and controller permissions. Supports debug logging and parent doctype delegation for child tables.

nodes.name: get_doc_permissions
nodes.summary: Returns evaluated permissions dict for a specific document, combining role permissions with owner-based if_owner permissions and user permission filtering.

nodes.name: get_role_permissions
nodes.summary: Returns cached role-based permission dict for a doctype/user, evaluating DocPerm rules against user roles with if_owner support.

nodes.name: has_user_permission
nodes.summary: Checks User Permission rules for a document, validating both self-permissions and link field permissions across parent and child documents with strict mode support.

nodes.name: get_roles
nodes.summary: Returns cached list of roles for a user, including automatic roles (Guest, All, Desk User) based on user type.

nodes.name: has_child_permission
nodes.summary: Checks permissions for child table doctypes by delegating to the parent doctype's permissions, validating parentfield and permlevel access.

nodes.name: file.py
nodes.summary: File document controller handling file upload, storage, validation, thumbnails, zip operations, privacy toggling, and permission checks. Manages both local and remote files with content hashing for deduplication.

nodes.name: File
nodes.summary: Document class for file management. Handles file creation, validation, storage on disk, privacy changes, thumbnails, zip/unzip, content deduplication via hashing, and rollback support.

nodes.name: has_permission
nodes.summary: Permission check for File documents. Handles admin bypass, public file read, owner check, share permissions, and cascading permissions from attached documents.

nodes.name: get_permission_query_conditions
nodes.summary: Returns SQL conditions to filter files based on user permissions, handling admin, system users, and regular users with readable doctypes.

nodes.name: email_queue.py
nodes.summary: Email queue system for sending emails. Contains EmailQueue document, SendMailContext for managing SMTP/FrappeMail delivery, QueueBuilder for composing and queuing emails with attachments, unsubscribe links, and retry logic.

nodes.name: EmailQueue
nodes.summary: Document class for email queue entries. Handles email sending via SMTP or Frappe Mail, recipient management, status tracking, retry logic, and old log cleanup.

nodes.name: SendMailContext
nodes.summary: Context manager for email sending. Handles SMTP server connection, message building with tracking pixels, unsubscribe links, CC/BCC exposure, attachment inclusion, and error notification on failure.

nodes.name: QueueBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder class for constructing EmailQueue entries. Handles recipient filtering (unsubscribe), email content formatting, attachments, batch sending for large recipient lists, and queue-separately mode.

nodes.name: print.js
nodes.summary: Print preview page UI. Provides print format selection, language/letterhead configuration, PDF generation, raw printing via QZ Tray, network printer support, and iframe-based print preview rendering.

nodes.name: PrintView
nodes.summary: Client-side print preview class. Manages print format selection, letterhead, language, sidebar controls, iframe rendering, PDF download, QZ Tray raw printing, and network printer integration.

nodes.name: google_calendar.py
nodes.summary: Google Calendar integration. Handles OAuth authorization, bidirectional sync of events between Frappe Calendar and Google Calendar, including recurrence rules, attendees, and Google Meet conferencing.

nodes.name: GoogleCalendar
nodes.summary: Document class for Google Calendar configuration. Validates Google API settings and manages OAuth access token refresh.

nodes.name: sync_events_from_google_calendar
nodes.summary: Pulls events from Google Calendar into Frappe. Handles pagination with sync tokens, creates/updates/cancels events, and manages recurrence rules and progress reporting.

nodes.name: insert_event_in_google_calendar
nodes.summary: Pushes a Frappe Event to Google Calendar via the API, including recurrence, attendees, and video conferencing setup.

nodes.name: update_event_in_google_calendar
nodes.summary: Updates an existing Google Calendar event when a Frappe Event is modified, including status changes, recurrence, attendees, and conferencing.

nodes.name: google_calendar_to_repeat_on
nodes.summary: Converts Google Calendar recurrence rules (RRULE format) to Frappe repeat_on fields, handling daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly patterns with day-of-week mapping.

nodes.name: web_form.py
nodes.summary: Web Form document type for creating public-facing forms. Handles form rendering, data submission, file attachments, permissions, list views, translations, and custom context/scripts.

nodes.name: WebForm
nodes.summary: WebsiteGenerator subclass for web forms. Manages form validation, context building for rendering, permission checks, attachment handling, breadcrumbs, translations, and custom JS/CSS injection.

nodes.name: accept
nodes.summary: Whitelisted endpoint to save web form submissions. Handles insert/update, file attachments with base64 decoding, anonymous submissions, and permission checks with rate limiting.

nodes.name: get_form_data
nodes.summary: API endpoint to fetch web form configuration and optionally the referenced document data with permission checks.

nodes.name: print_format_builder.js
nodes.summary: Visual drag-and-drop print format builder. Allows creating and editing print formats with sections, columns, field ordering, table column selection, custom HTML, and heading customization.

nodes.name: PrintFormatBuilder
nodes.summary: Client-side print format builder with drag-and-drop interface. Manages layout data (sections/columns/fields), sortable interactions, field/section settings dialogs, custom HTML editing, and serialization to format_data JSON.

nodes.name: chart_widget.js
nodes.summary: Dashboard chart widget extending base Widget. Supports multiple chart types (line, bar, pie, donut, heatmap), time series filters, report-based charts, custom filters, data export, and user-specific chart settings.

nodes.name: ChartWidget
nodes.summary: Dashboard chart widget class extending Widget. Handles chart rendering via frappe-charts, data fetching from document types/reports/custom sources, time series filtering, heatmap support, filter dialogs, and chart configuration persistence.

nodes.name: reportview.py
nodes.summary: Report view backend for list views and report builder. Handles query building, field/filter validation, data compression, CSV/Excel export, report saving/deletion, sidebar stats, and bulk delete operations.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Main whitelisted endpoint for list view data. Parses form params, executes database query (or virtual doctype controller), and returns compressed key-value data.

nodes.name: get_count
nodes.summary: Returns count of records for list view with timeout protection. Uses subquery counting with optional statement timeout to prevent long-running queries.

nodes.name: export_query
nodes.summary: Exports report builder data to CSV or Excel. Supports background export for large datasets, field translation, duration formatting, and access logging.

nodes.name: validate_fields
nodes.summary: Validates requested fields against doctype metadata, checking for permission levels and report_hide flags. Removes unauthorized or hidden fields from the query.

nodes.name: delete_items
nodes.summary: Bulk delete endpoint for list view. Enqueues deletion for large batches (>10 items) and provides progress reporting via realtime events.

nodes.name: model.js
nodes.summary: Core client-side model layer. Defines field type constants, standard fields, permission checking utilities, document CRUD operations, event triggers, realtime doc update handling, and model utility functions.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Initializes the client-side model layer with realtime doc_update event handler for conflict detection and automatic reload of clean documents.

nodes.name: set_value
nodes.summary: Sets document field values locally and triggers change events. Supports bulk updates via object parameter and handles link field re-triggers.

nodes.name: with_doctype
nodes.summary: Ensures a doctype's metadata is loaded, fetching from server if needed. Initializes doctype assets (JS, templates) and stores user settings.

nodes.name: customize_form.py
nodes.summary: Customize Form single doctype for modifying standard doctypes without editing source. Manages property setters, custom fields, field ordering, fieldtype change validation, and doctype property customization.

nodes.name: CustomizeForm
nodes.summary: Single DocType document for customizing standard doctypes. Handles loading meta properties, saving customizations via property setters, managing custom fields, validating fieldtype changes, field ordering, links/actions/states customization, and reset functionality.

nodes.name: reset_customization
nodes.summary: Removes all non-system-generated property setters and custom fields for a doctype, restoring it to its standard state.

nodes.name: FileUploader.vue
nodes.summary: Vue 3 component for file uploading with drag-and-drop, file browser, web link, camera capture, Google Drive integration, and chunked upload support. Handles file restrictions, image cropping, and multiple upload sources.

nodes.name: workspace.js
nodes.summary: Workspace page view using EditorJS for block-based content editing. Manages workspace CRUD operations, sidebar navigation, page rendering with sortable blocks, and workspace customization with save/discard functionality.

nodes.name: layout.js
nodes.summary: Form layout engine that renders form fields organized into tabs, sections, and columns. Handles field dependency evaluation (depends_on, mandatory_depends_on, read_only_depends_on), tab navigation, keyboard tab handling, and dynamic field refresh.

nodes.name: widget_dialog.js
nodes.summary: Collection of dialog classes for creating/editing workspace widgets including charts, shortcuts, links/cards, number cards, quick lists, onboarding, and custom blocks. Each subclass provides specific form fields and data processing.

nodes.name: background_jobs.py
nodes.summary: Background job infrastructure built on Redis Queue (RQ). Provides enqueue/execute functions, worker management (FrappeWorker, FrappeWorkerNoFork), queue validation, job deduplication, retry logic for deadlocks, and Sentry integration for background processes.

nodes.name: form_timeline.js
nodes.summary: Form timeline component that renders activity history including emails, comments, versions, shares, assignments, attachments, milestones, likes, and workflow logs. Supports email composition with reply/reply-all and inline comment editing.

nodes.name: filter.js
nodes.summary: UI filter component that provides condition-based filtering with support for various field types, operators (equals, like, in, between, timespan, nested set), special condition labels, and configurable filter extensions via boot config.

nodes.name: backups.py
nodes.summary: Backup system with BackupGenerator class for database dumps (MariaDB/PostgreSQL/SQLite), file archives, site config backup, GPG encryption support, partial backups with include/exclude doctypes, and scheduled cleanup of old backups.

nodes.name: auth.py
nodes.summary: Authentication and session management module. Contains HTTPRequest for request initialization, LoginManager for login/logout/2FA/session handling, CookieManager for cookie operations, and validators for OAuth, API keys, CSRF tokens, and IP restrictions with login attempt tracking.

nodes.name: setup_wizard.js
nodes.summary: Setup wizard page with multi-step slide-based UI for initial site configuration. Includes language/country/timezone selection, user profile setup, domain filtering, real-time progress tracking, and regional data binding.

nodes.name: Workspace
nodes.summary: Main workspace view class managing EditorJS-based page rendering, CRUD operations for workspace pages, sidebar integration, block sorting, and page state management.

nodes.name: Layout
nodes.summary: Form layout engine organizing fields into tabs, sections, and columns. Evaluates depends_on expressions, handles field refresh, tab navigation, and keyboard tab handling.

nodes.name: WidgetDialog
nodes.summary: Base dialog class for creating/editing workspace widgets. Provides common dialog structure, filter setup, and field show/hide utilities. Subclassed by ChartDialog, ShortcutDialog, CardDialog, NumberCardDialog, QuickListDialog, OnboardingDialog, CustomBlockDialog.

nodes.name: ShortcutDialog
nodes.summary: Dialog for creating/editing workspace shortcuts with support for DocType, Report, Page, Dashboard, and URL types, including filter configuration and count customization.

nodes.name: NumberCardDialog
nodes.summary: Dialog for creating/editing number card widgets with aggregate functions (Count, Sum, Average, Min, Max) and filter support.

nodes.name: FormTimeline
nodes.summary: Timeline component displaying document activity history including communications, comments, versions, shares, assignments, attachments, milestones, and workflow logs with email reply and comment editing.

nodes.name: Filter
nodes.summary: UI filter control handling field selection, condition operators, value input, filter tags, and field type transformations for list view and report filtering.

nodes.name: BackupGenerator
nodes.summary: Generates database backups (MariaDB/PostgreSQL/SQLite), file archives, and site config backups with support for partial backups, GPG encryption, compression, and email notifications.

nodes.name: HTTPRequest
nodes.summary: HTTP request handler that initializes request IP, cookies, session, language, and validates CSRF tokens. Entry point for all authenticated requests.

nodes.name: LoginManager
nodes.summary: Manages user login/logout lifecycle including authentication, 2FA, session creation, password reset enforcement, IP validation, and hour restrictions.

nodes.name: CookieManager
nodes.summary: Manages HTTP cookies for session management including setting, deleting, and flushing cookies to the response with security attributes.

nodes.name: LoginAttemptTracker
nodes.summary: Tracks consecutive login failures per user/IP using Redis cache and locks accounts after exceeding configurable thresholds for a configurable interval.

nodes.name: FrappeWorker
nodes.summary: Extended RQ Worker that starts the Frappe scheduler as a daemon thread and disables the built-in RQ scheduler.

nodes.name: FrappeWorkerNoFork
nodes.summary: Non-forking RQ worker that executes jobs in the same process. Handles job timeout exceptions and restarts after a configurable max number of jobs.

nodes.name: SetupWizard
nodes.summary: Multi-step setup wizard extending frappe.ui.Slides for initial site configuration with keyboard navigation, real-time progress tracking, domain-based slide filtering, and abort/retry support.

nodes.name: SetupWizardSlide
nodes.summary: Individual setup wizard slide extending frappe.ui.Slide with initial value setting and telemetry event tracking.

nodes.name: enqueue
nodes.summary: Primary API for enqueuing background jobs via RQ with support for deduplication, after-commit scheduling, queue starvation detection, timeout configuration, and success/failure callbacks.

nodes.name: execute_job
nodes.summary: Executes a background job in a worker context with site initialization, user setting, commit/rollback handling, deadlock retry logic, and before/after job hooks.

nodes.name: start_worker
nodes.summary: Starts an RQ worker process connecting to Redis and monitoring specified queues with configurable logging and dequeue strategy.

nodes.name: start_worker_pool
nodes.summary: Starts a pool of RQ workers with pre-loaded modules for memory sharing, supporting both forking and non-forking worker modes.

nodes.name: scheduled_backup
nodes.summary: Scheduler entry point for creating backups, delegates to new_backup after deleting old temp backups.

nodes.name: validate_auth
nodes.summary: Authenticates requests via OAuth bearer tokens, API key/secret pairs, or custom auth hooks and raises AuthenticationError on failure.

nodes.name: validate_ip_address
nodes.summary: Validates if a user's request IP is in their allowed IP list, with bypass option for 2FA-enabled users.

nodes.name: upload_file
nodes.summary: Handles file upload via XMLHttpRequest with chunked upload support, progress tracking, and comprehensive error handling for various HTTP status codes.

nodes.name: sidebar.js
nodes.summary: Main sidebar UI component for the desk. Manages workspace navigation, sidebar items, promotional banners, onboarding widgets, and sidebar expand/collapse state. Handles route-based workspace switching and module-to-sidebar mapping.

nodes.name: Sidebar
nodes.summary: Core sidebar class managing workspace navigation sidebar with item rendering, expand/collapse, promotional banners, onboarding setup, route-based workspace switching, and module mapping.

nodes.name: html_utils.py
nodes.summary: HTML sanitization utilities using nh3 library. Provides functions to clean HTML for general use, email content, and full XSS prevention. Defines whitelists for acceptable HTML/SVG/MathML elements, attributes, and CSS properties.

nodes.name: clean_html
nodes.summary: Basic HTML cleaning that strips to a minimal set of safe tags using nh3.

nodes.name: clean_email_html
nodes.summary: Sanitizes HTML for email content, allowing a broader set of tags, attributes, and CSS properties suitable for email rendering.

nodes.name: sanitize_html
nodes.summary: Full HTML sanitization for XSS prevention using nh3 with comprehensive whitelists for HTML5, SVG, and MathML elements and attributes. Skips JSON content by default.

nodes.name: safe_exec.py
nodes.summary: Server Script sandboxed execution environment using RestrictedPython. Provides safe_exec and safe_eval functions with a curated namespace of allowed frappe APIs, database access (read-only SQL), and Python builtins. Guards against unsafe attribute access and module imports.

nodes.name: NamespaceDict
nodes.summary: Extended frappe._dict that raises AttributeError for missing keys starting with underscore, used as the namespace container for safe execution.

nodes.name: FrappeTransformer
nodes.summary: Custom RestrictedPython node transformer that allows '_dict' name usage in server scripts.

nodes.name: safe_exec
nodes.summary: Executes a Python script string in a sandboxed environment with RestrictedPython compilation and a curated set of safe globals. Optionally restricts commit/rollback for doc events.

nodes.name: get_safe_globals
nodes.summary: Builds the safe globals namespace for server script execution, exposing curated frappe APIs (get_doc, get_list, db operations, utils, etc.), RestrictedPython guards, and Python builtins.

nodes.name: safe_eval
nodes.summary: Safely evaluates a Python expression with restricted globals and validation against named expressions.

nodes.name: check_safe_sql_query
nodes.summary: Validates that a SQL query is read-only (SELECT or EXPLAIN) for use in restricted server script context.

nodes.name: get_keys_for_autocomplete
nodes.summary: Recursively generates autocomplete suggestions from the safe exec namespace for server script editor.

nodes.name: permission_manager.js
nodes.summary: Role Permissions Manager page UI. Allows viewing, adding, removing, and resetting permission rules for doctypes and roles. Renders a permission table with checkboxes for granular permission types (read, write, create, delete, etc.) and an activity log viewer.

nodes.name: PermissionEngine
nodes.summary: Permission management engine that renders doctype permission tables, handles adding/removing/updating permission rules, shows users with roles, and displays permission activity logs.

nodes.name: rename_doc.py
nodes.summary: Document renaming and bulk rename logic. Handles renaming a document's name across all linked fields, dynamic links, child tables, user settings, attachments, versions, and DocType-specific operations (field options, sequences). Supports merge with existing documents.

nodes.name: rename_doc
nodes.summary: Core document rename function that updates the document name across all linked fields, dynamic links, child tables, user settings, attachments, and versions. Supports merge and rebuild search.

nodes.name: update_document_title
nodes.summary: Whitelisted API to update a document's title and/or name, with optional enqueue for background processing.

nodes.name: validate_rename
nodes.summary: Validates rename operation: checks existence, permissions, merge target, naming rules, and uses savepoints for safe validation.

nodes.name: get_link_fields
nodes.summary: Retrieves all Link-type fields pointing to a given doctype from DocField, Custom Field, and Property Setter tables. Results are cached in frappe.flags.

nodes.name: bulk_rename
nodes.summary: Bulk rename documents from a list of (oldname, newname, merge) tuples with error handling and global search rebuild.

nodes.name: rename_dynamic_links
nodes.summary: Updates all Dynamic Link fields that reference the renamed document, handling both single and regular doctypes.

nodes.name: printview.py
nodes.summary: Print view rendering for documents. Generates HTML output for print formats using Jinja2 templates, handles letter heads, print styles, fonts, layout building, column visibility, and print permissions. Supports both standard and custom print formats including WeasyPrint.

nodes.name: get_context
nodes.summary: Builds the full print context including body HTML, styles, letter head, and metadata for rendering a document's print view.

nodes.name: get_rendered_template
nodes.summary: Renders a document using its print format template (standard or custom) with letter head, print settings, and layout. Core function for PDF/print generation.

nodes.name: make_layout
nodes.summary: Builds a hierarchical page layout from document fields for the standard print template, handling sections, columns, tables, and page breaks.

nodes.name: get_visible_columns
nodes.summary: Returns list of visible table columns for print based on print_hide settings and whether columns have values.

nodes.name: get_html_and_style
nodes.summary: Whitelisted API returning rendered HTML and CSS for a document's print format.

nodes.name: desktop.py
nodes.summary: Workspace/desktop page builder. The Workspace class loads workspace configuration and builds cards, charts, shortcuts, number cards, quick lists, and custom blocks with permission filtering. Also provides sidebar items API, onboarding data, and widget management functions.

nodes.name: Workspace
nodes.summary: Workspace page builder that loads workspace configuration, filters items by permissions/domains, and builds cards, charts, shortcuts, number cards, quick lists, and custom blocks for desk rendering.

nodes.name: get_desktop_page
nodes.summary: Whitelisted API that builds and returns the full workspace page configuration (charts, shortcuts, cards, etc.) with permission filtering.

nodes.name: get_workspace_sidebar_items
nodes.summary: Whitelisted API returning filtered and sorted workspace sidebar items based on user roles, domains, and modules for desk navigation.

nodes.name: get_onboarding_data
nodes.summary: Returns module onboarding steps and status for the sidebar onboarding widget.

nodes.name: router.js
nodes.summary: Client-side SPA router for the desk application. Handles URL parsing, route resolution, pushState navigation, route conversion between standard (List/Form/Tree) and slug formats, history management, and external link warnings.

nodes.name: route
nodes.summary: Main routing function that resolves the current URL, parses it into a standard route, renders the appropriate page, and updates history and title.

nodes.name: convert_to_standard_route
nodes.summary: Converts URL path segments into standard route arrays (e.g., slug to ['List', 'DocType'] or ['Form', 'DocType', 'name']).

nodes.name: set_route
nodes.summary: Sets a new route via pushState, converting standard route format to URL slug format, handling route options and new tab opening.

nodes.name: show_external_link_warning_if_needed
nodes.summary: Shows a confirmation dialog when user clicks an external link, with configurable warning levels and per-domain skip option.

nodes.name: communication.py
nodes.summary: Communication document controller handling email communications. Manages email validation, sender resolution, timeline links, contact auto-creation, delivery status tracking, email signatures, spam marking, and parent document updates (first response time, avg response time).

nodes.name: Communication
nodes.summary: Document class for Communication doctype. Handles email lifecycle including validation, sender resolution, timeline link management, delivery status, spam detection, email signatures, and real-time notifications.

nodes.name: update_parent_document_on_communication
nodes.summary: Updates the parent document's status, first response time, and average response time when a communication is received or sent.

nodes.name: parse_email
nodes.summary: Parses email addresses containing embedded doctype+docname references (RFC5233 subaddressing) for automatic timeline linking.

nodes.name: get_permission_query_conditions_for_communication
nodes.summary: Returns SQL conditions to filter communications based on user's email accounts, bypassed for Super Email User and System Manager roles.

nodes.name: search_utils.js
nodes.summary: Search utilities for the awesome bar (global search). Provides fuzzy search across recent pages, doctypes, reports, pages, desktop icons, dashboards, marketplace apps, and global search results. Handles result ranking, deduplication, and marked string highlighting.

nodes.name: get_nav_results
nodes.summary: Aggregates navigation search results from multiple sources (recents, creatables, lists, reports, pages, icons, dashboards) into categorized result sets for the awesome bar.

nodes.name: fuzzy_search
nodes.summary: Performs fuzzy matching between keywords and items, returning a score and optionally a marked string with highlighted match positions.

nodes.name: get_global_results
nodes.summary: Fetches global search results from the server and formats them into categorized result sets with highlighted descriptions.

nodes.name: email_body.py
nodes.summary: Email composition module that builds MIME multipart email messages with HTML/text content, inline images, attachments, and styling. Handles email formatting, header sanitization, inline CSS conversion via premailer, and embedded image replacement with CID references.

nodes.name: EMail
nodes.summary: Wrapper around Python email module for constructing multipart email messages with HTML/text alternatives, attachments, validation, sender replacement, and MIME structure building.

nodes.name: get_email
nodes.summary: Factory function that creates an EMail object with recipients, sender, subject, HTML content, attachments and priority settings.

nodes.name: get_formatted_html

tour.title: Framework Entry Point
tour.description: Start with frappe/__init__.py — the heart of the framework. This module initializes the frappe namespace, provides the global `frappe` object with lazy-loaded attributes (db, conf, session), and exposes the most commonly used API functions like get_doc(), get_list(), call(), and throw(). Every frappe operation begins here.

tour.title: WSGI Application & Request Handling
tour.description: frappe/app.py defines the WSGI application that processes all HTTP requests. It sets up the request/response cycle, initializes the site, handles static files, and routes requests to the appropriate handlers. frappe/handler.py then dispatches API calls (RPC, file uploads, document methods).

tour.title: Authentication & Sessions
tour.description: frappe/auth.py manages the authentication pipeline — login/logout, password verification, OTP/2FA, LDAP, and social login. frappe/sessions.py handles session lifecycle with Redis-backed storage, generating the boot info that configures the entire client-side experience.

tour.title: The Document Model (DocType)
tour.description: The core abstraction in frappe is the Document. frappe/model/document.py defines the Document class with its lifecycle hooks (before_save, validate, on_update, etc.), CRUD operations, and permission checks. Every business object in frappe is a Document.

tour.title: Database Layer
tour.description: frappe/database/ provides a unified database abstraction supporting both MariaDB and PostgreSQL. The Database class offers query building, transaction management, and schema operations. It translates frappe's ORM calls into efficient SQL.

tour.title: Permissions & Access Control
tour.description: frappe/permissions.py implements a comprehensive RBAC system. It evaluates role permissions, user permissions, document-level security, and sharing rules. Every document access goes through this layer to enforce the security model.

tour.title: Client-Side Framework
tour.description: The desk UI starts with the client-side model layer (model.js), page infrastructure (page.js), and form system (layout.js, toolbar.js). These JavaScript modules build the admin interface that users interact with daily.

tour.title: List & Report Views
tour.description: The desk provides multiple ways to view data: list_view.js renders tabular lists with filters, sorting and bulk operations; report_view.js handles report builder and query reports; kanban_board.js provides card-based views.

tour.title: Website & Routing
tour.description: frappe/website/router.py handles public-facing website routing — resolving URLs to pages, web forms, and dynamic routes. frappe/client.py provides the REST API handler for /api/resource endpoints.

tour.title: Email & Notifications
tour.description: The email system handles both sending (email_queue.py, email_body.py) and receiving (receive.py). The notification system (notification.py) triggers automated alerts across Email, Slack, SMS, and system notification channels.

tour.title: Background Jobs & Caching
tour.description: frappe uses Redis for both caching (redis_wrapper.py) and background job processing (background_jobs.py with RQ workers). This infrastructure enables async operations, scheduled tasks, and high-performance data access.

tour.title: Admin Tools & Customization
tour.description: frappe provides powerful admin capabilities: installer.py for site/app management, setup_wizard for initial configuration, customize_form for runtime DocType modifications, and data import/export tools for bulk operations.
